Google Sites Compatibility

Build or Export for Google Sites

Every section, asymmetrical two-column layout, and 3-card evidence grid in this portfolio uses native structural blocks that map directly to Google Sites. You can either copy your edited page text into Google Sites or download a standalone HTML file to embed.

1. Google Sites Theme & Page Setup

  • Create Custom Theme: In Google Sites, open Themes → Create theme. Set Background to #FAF7F2 (Ivory), Accent to #B86B52 (Terracotta), Title font to Cormorant Garamond, and Body font to Plus Jakarta Sans.
  • Create 6 Subpages: In the Pages panel, add 6 pages matching the navigation menu: Where I Started, My Best Work, Biggest Challenge, How I Improved, Learning With Others, and My Next Chapter.
  • Link Homepage Gallery: Insert 6 large Image blocks in an asymmetrical 2-column grid on Home, click each image, and select Insert link → Select corresponding page.
  • Add 3 Evidence Slots per Page: Use Google Sites’ built-in 3-Column Content Block on each page to place your assignment screenshots, notebook photos, and feedback images with captions.
